messages.subject: efa function
parts:
Hi,
I want to use the ULS estimator in efa function in lavaan. I have ordinal data.
How can I set this estimator in efa? "estimator" option does not work in efa function!
Thanks,
HO

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: efa function
parts: How can I set this estimator in efa? "estimator" option does not work in efa function!

Works for me:

HS9 <- HolzingerSwineford1939[,c("x1","x2","x3","x4","x5",
                                 "x6","x7","x8","x9")]
HSbinary <- as.data.frame( lapply(HS9, cut, 2, labels=FALSE) )
fit <- efa(data = HSbinary,
           ov.names = paste("x", 1:9, sep = ""),
           nfactors = 1:3,
           rotation = "geomin",
           ordered = TRUE, estimator = "ULS",
           rotation.args = list(geomin.epsilon = 0.01, rstarts = 1))
summary(fit, nd = 3L, cutoff = 0.2, dot.cutoff = 0.05)
